outcome: diagnosis of congenital cystic adenomatoid malformation (CCAM)
cohort: The study describes a 30-year-old female patient pregnant with twins.
finding: Prenatal ultrasonography at 20 weeks gestation revealed a microcystic-type CCAM characterized by a hyperechoic mass filling the left hemithorax and causing mediastinal shift, which was confirmed by microscopic examination at autopsy.
